data.name: A little more peace of mind.
A safer system should not be a locked-down system. Edit your files. Build your tools. Make the desktop your own. Pro does not take away the open-source freedoms that brought you here.
data.value: 更安全的系统不应是一个封闭的系统。编辑你的文件，构建你的工具，让桌面成为你自己的。Pro 版本不会夺走那些将你带到这里来的开源自由。

data.name: A separate environment. A familiar way back.
data.value: 独立环境，熟悉的回归之路。

data.name: Actual development build. Final interface may change.
data.value: 实际开发版本。最终界面可能会更改。

data.name: Actual recovery environment. Availability depends on the release and installation layout.
data.value: 实际恢复环境。可用性取决于发布版本和安装布局。

data.name: An operating system that puts your data first. More protection. A way back. And the freedom to make it yours.
data.value: 一款将数据安全置于首位的操作系统。更多保护，随时回退，自由定制。

data.name: An update goes wrong. Your desktop will not start. An independent recovery environment gives you another route in, so you can restore a usable system snapshot without rolling back your personal files.
data.value: 更新失败，桌面无法启动。独立的恢复环境为您提供另一条进入路径，让您能够恢复可用的系统快照，而无需回退个人文件。

data.name: AnduinOS Recovery Environment showing a system snapshot and the Roll Back action
data.value: AnduinOS 恢复环境，显示系统快照和回滚操作

data.name: Built for the moments you need it.

Changing boot components may require signing and key enrollment to keep Secure Boot enabled. Custom changes can affect bootability and support eligibility. Protection is not a promise that every modification is safe.
data.value: 更改启动组件可能需要签名和密钥注册才能保持安全启动处于启用状态。自定义更改可能会影响启动能力和支持资格。保护措施并不保证所有修改都是安全的。

data.name: Community and planned Pro benefits. Pro is not yet available to purchase.
data.value: 社区版与计划推出的 Pro 版权益。Pro 版目前尚未开放购买。

data.name: Depends on release and installation layout
data.value: 取决于版本和安装布局

data.name: Development build of Driver Center showing encrypted system files, Home and disk swap
data.value: 驱动程序中心开发版本，显示加密的系统文件、主目录和磁盘交换

data.name: Discover AnduinOS Pro: planned disk encryption, recovery integration and one year of official support. One free ISO, optional Pro benefits. Currently in development.
data.value: 了解 AnduinOS Pro：计划中的磁盘加密、恢复集成和一年的官方支持。一个免费 ISO，可选的 Pro 权益。目前处于开发阶段。

data.name: Encryption and recovery do not remove your ability to modify the system. Existing open-source licence rights remain unchanged.
data.value: 加密和恢复功能不会剥夺您修改系统的能力。现有的开源许可证权利保持不变。

data.name: Encryption protects confidentiality; it does not prevent deletion or disk failure. Keep independent backups and store your recovery key away from the computer. Pro encryption is still in development.
data.value: 加密保护的是机密性，无法防止数据被删除或磁盘故障。请保留独立的备份，并将恢复密钥存放在电脑以外的地方。Pro 加密功能仍在开发中。

data.name: Firefox, everyday apps and ordinary updates
In development. Not yet available to purchase.
Keep the local Pro features of your purchased version. Get one year of official support. Stay free to make it your own.
data.value: 保留您购买版本中的本地 Pro 功能。享受一年官方支持。保持自由，随心定制。

data.name: Make room for what matters.
data.value: 为重要的事物腾出空间。

data.name: More protection. A way back. And the freedom to make it yours. Explore the AnduinOS Pro preview.
data.value: 更多保护。一条退路。以及让它成为你自己的自由。探索 AnduinOS Pro 预览版。

data.name: No operating system can guarantee against every cause of data loss. Encryption, snapshots and a recovery environment serve different purposes. An independent, tested backup remains essential.
data.value: 没有任何操作系统能够保证防范所有导致数据丢失的原因。加密、快照和恢复环境各有不同的用途。独立且经过测试的备份仍然是必不可少的。

data.name: Not in the standard installer
data.value: 标准安装程序中不包含

data.name: Offline update packages and extra wallpapers
data.value: 离线更新包和额外壁纸

data.name: On a supported installation, recovery runs independently of the installed desktop and does not need an internet connection.
data.value: 在受支持的系统中，恢复环境独立于已安装的桌面运行，且无需互联网连接。

data.name: One free ISO. Optional Pro benefits.
data.value: 一个免费 ISO。可选 Pro 权益。

data.name: One public ISO per release and architecture. No payment or login to download. Pro benefits are optional; Firefox and ordinary updates do not depend on activation. The support period is not a promise of lifetime maintenance or all future versions.
data.value: 每个版本和架构提供一个公共 ISO。下载无需支付或登录。Pro 权益为可选项；Firefox 和普通更新不依赖于激活。支持期并非终身维护或所有未来版本的承诺。

data.name: Protection should start before your desktop does. AnduinOS brings signed boot components and a machine-local signing identity together, with a clear path to checking what your computer trusts.
data.value: 安全防护应早于桌面环境启动。AnduinOS 将经过签名的启动组件与本机签名身份相结合，并提供清晰的路径来检查您的计算机所信任的内容。

data.name: Public ISO download. No account required.
data.value: 公开 ISO 下载。无需账户。

data.name: Requires a working boot path, readable recovery storage and a usable snapshot. Same-disk recovery cannot rescue a failed drive. Existing community recovery remains available; the encrypted Pro workflow is being validated.
data.value: 需要可用的引导路径、可读的恢复存储以及可用的快照。同盘恢复无法拯救故障硬盘。现有的社区恢复功能仍可使用；加密的 Pro 工作流程正在验证中。

data.name: Root, personal files and disk swap are covered by the supported encrypted installation layout.
data.value: 受支持的加密安装布局涵盖了根分区、个人文件和磁盘交换分区。

data.name: Secure Boot is also available in the community edition. Hardware, firmware and key enrollment requirements apply. End-to-end qualification of the encrypted Pro and recovery paths is still in progress; this diagram is not a claim that every system file is verified.
data.value: 安全启动（Secure Boot）在社区版中也可用。需满足硬件、固件和密钥注册要求。加密 Pro 版和恢复路径的端到端资格认证仍在进行中；此图并非声称每个系统文件均已经过验证。

data.name: See your Secure Boot state in Driver Center. Keep control of your machine's trust configuration.
data.value: 在驱动程序中心查看您的安全启动状态。掌控您设备的信任配置。

data.name: Signed bootloader
data.value: 已签名的引导加载程序

data.name: Supported hardware and enrollment required
data.value: 需要支持该功能的硬件及密钥注册

data.name: The AnduinOS desktop with its blue wallpaper and application menu
data.value: 配有蓝色壁纸和应用菜单的 AnduinOS 桌面

data.name: The familiar AnduinOS desktop. A new layer of peace of mind.
data.value: 熟悉的 AnduinOS 桌面。多一份安心保障。

data.name: The same free download for everyone. Choose Pro when you want the extra benefits and official support.
data.value: 同样的免费下载，面向所有人。当你需要更多权益和官方支持时，请选择 Pro 版。

data.name: The work you have not published. The photos you cannot retake. The ideas you are just getting started on. Pro brings extra protection and official support to the desktop you already love.
data.value: 你尚未发布的工作，无法重拍的照片，刚刚起步的灵感。Pro 为你挚爱的桌面系统带来额外的保护和官方支持。

data.name: This is a preview of the planned offer, not a final release feature list. Existing community features and third-party licence rights are not paywalled. Final features, tax treatment, support terms and availability will be confirmed before sales open.
data.value: 此为计划中的优惠预览，并非最终发布的功能列表。现有社区功能及第三方许可权利不受付费墙限制。最终功能、税务处理、支持条款及可用性将在销售开启前予以确认。

data.name: Up to seven eligible devices under one account
data.value: 一个账号下最多支持七台符合条件的设备

data.name: Your files should not become someone else's files. The Pro encryption workflow is designed to protect your system and personal data when your computer is powered off.
data.value: 您的文件不应成为他人的文件。Pro 加密工作流程旨在当您的计算机处于关机状态时，保护您的系统和数据。

data.name: Your files should not become someone else's files. The Pro encryption workflow is designed to protect your system and personal data when your computer is switched off and locked.
data.value: 您的文件不应成为他人的文件。Pro 加密工作流程旨在保护您的系统和个人数据，确保在电脑关机或锁定时的安全。

data.name: Your OS should be ready.
data.value: 您的操作系统应随时待命。
